theorems.statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x₀ : Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → x₀ ∈ M → coareaJacobian M f x₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (Ω : Set (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))) (O : Set (Rn N)) (Ψ : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) → Rn N), IsOpen Ω ∧ IsOpen O ∧ x₀ ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ Ω ∧ InjOn Ψ Ω ∧ Ψ '' Ω = O ∩ M ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Ψ p)) ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ω, f (Ψ p) = WithLp.fst p) ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ω, tangentSpace M (Ψ p) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Ψ p).toLinearMap
